title: How to Attend K-Pop Music Shows in Seoul: Complete 2026 Guide
description: Step-by-step guide to attending Music Bank, Inkigayo, M Countdown, and Show Champion in Seoul — ticket applications, timing, and what to expect.
content:
Watching your favorite K-pop artists perform live on Music Bank or Inkigayo is a bucket-list experience for fans visiting Seoul. The good news: it's free. The catch: it takes planning. Here's exactly how to make it happen.

The Major Music Shows

  • Music Bank (KBS2) — Fridays, recording starts ~3PM at KBS Hall in Yeouido
  • Inkigayo (SBS) — Sundays, recording starts ~3PM at SBS Prism Tower in Mapo
  • M Countdown (Mnet) — Thursdays, at CJ ENM Center in Sangam
  • Show Champion (MBC Music) — Wednesdays, at MBC Dream Center in Ilsan

How to Get Tickets (Standing Audience Slots)

Music shows are free to attend but require an application through fan cafes or the official show's Korean application system. The process:

  1. Check the show's official Naver fancafe or website for that week's lineup announcement (usually Tuesday for Friday shows)
  2. Submit an application form with your name, nationality, and contact info
  3. If approved, collect your wristband at the venue 2-3 hours before recording
  4. Line up early — slots are given on a first-come basis among applicants
💡 Reality Check: Getting into shows featuring BTS, BLACKPINK, or TWICE is extremely difficult. Shows featuring mid-tier acts or newer groups are much more accessible.

What to Bring

  • Your passport (identity verification required)
  • Phone fully charged (airplane mode during recording)
  • Light snacks — you'll wait 3-4 hours total
  • Fan merchandise of the artists performing (shows it to staff, improves your queue position)

Fan Club Advantage

Joining an artist's official fan club (Weverse, Bubble, or fancafe) significantly improves your chances. Fan club members often get priority application access.

🚇

Navigate Seoul Like a Pro

T-money card works on all Seoul Metro lines. Load it at any station convenience store.
